ui.name: dateField
ui.label: Timeframe applies to
ui.help: Which ticket date the selected timeframe filters on. Set the timeframe to **None** to ignore dates entirely and return the current backlog.

ui.name: statusClass
ui.label: Status
ui.help: Leave empty for all tickets. Filtering here is done by TeamDynamix rather than in the browser, so it also keeps large result sets manageable.

ui.name: groups
ui.label: Group(s)
ui.help: Matches the group a ticket is assigned to, not groups that only own one of its tasks.
